window.note: Upstream additions dated after the GTFS Guru release named here are listed as new. Differences that are not fully supported are listed regardless of age, so an open gap never ages off the page.

entries.title: min_transfer_time became Conditionally Required
entries.summary: The reference changed `min_transfer_time` from **Optional** to **Conditionally Required**: it is now Required when `transfer_type` is `2`. gtfs.guru already enforced exactly that condition, so no behaviour changed.

entries.title: from_area_id
entries.summary: GTFS Fares v2 area column. The reference lists only the network and stop pairs for this file, so gtfs.guru reads the column instead of reporting `unknown_column`.

entries.title: to_area_id
entries.summary: GTFS Fares v2 area column. The reference lists only the network and stop pairs for this file, so gtfs.guru reads the column instead of reporting `unknown_column`.

entries.title: location_group_desc
entries.summary: Read alongside `location_group_name`. The reference lists no description column for this file, so gtfs.guru reads the column instead of reporting `unknown_column`.

entries.title: route_branding_url
entries.summary: Google Transit extension the reference does not list.

entries.title: continuous_drop_off
entries.summary: Google Transit extension the reference does not list on `trips.txt`; the reference specifies the equivalent columns on `routes.txt` and `stop_times.txt`.

entries.title: continuous_pickup
entries.summary: Google Transit extension the reference does not list on `trips.txt`; the reference specifies the equivalent columns on `routes.txt` and `stop_times.txt`.

entries.title: transfers
entries.summary: The reference marks it **Required**, but an empty value is defined as unlimited transfers and occurs in published feeds, so gtfs.guru does not require a value.

entries.title: timeframe_group_id
entries.summary: The reference marks it **Required**; gtfs.guru requires only `service_id` here. A missing group id surfaces as a foreign-key violation on `fare_leg_rules.from_timeframe_group_id`/`to_timeframe_group_id` rather than as a missing-column error.

entries.title: transfer_type
entries.summary: The reference marks it **Required**, but an empty value is defined as `0` (recommended transfer point), so gtfs.guru does not require a value.

entries.title: agency_phone_invalid

entries.title: missing_prior_day_booking_field_value
entries.summary: Deprecated by the canonical validator in 7.0.0, which separated it into `missing_prior_notice_last_day` and `missing_prior_notice_last_time`. gtfs.guru emits all three, so a feed validated here reports the deprecated code alongside its replacements.

entries.title: missing_recommended_column
entries.summary: Deprecated by the canonical validator in 7.0.0 as an unused notice. gtfs.guru still reports it in `--thorough` mode.

entries.title: service_never_active
entries.summary: A gtfs.guru rule with no canonical equivalent: every weekday flag is `0` and `calendar_dates.txt` adds no service date, so trips using the service never run.
